**Role:** <!-- Write curator, or contributor/<domain>/<project>. Every delegate posts as the
same account, so this line is the only thing that says who is speaking. -->

## What is blocked

<!-- Say it exactly, with the path, the branch or the command. Write "I cannot add
`gui_shim.cpp`, because `.cpp` is not a registered kind" and not "the audit is strict". -->

## Which rule or check stands in the way

<!-- Name it: the article, the duty, or the module. Where you are not sure which one, quote
the error word for word. -->

## What you tried, and why you rejected it

<!-- The workarounds you weighed and did not take. This is the most useful section. It saves
the curator the work of ruling out what you already ruled out. It also shows that you
respected the rule rather than went around it. -->

## What you propose

<!-- A change, as exact as you can make it. "Register `.cpp` in `kinds.nim` with `//`
comments" beats "allow C++". Where you cannot see a fix, say so. To name the problem is
enough. -->

## What it costs to decline

<!-- What you will do instead, and what is lost. Where the honest answer is "little, and I
can wait", write that too. A curator who weighs this needs to know when it is not urgent. -->
